lines.en: label day217:
scene black
Time: 4:23 PM\nLocation: Karaoke Room 4
lines.zh: 时间：下午 4:23\n地点：4 号卡拉 OK 房

lines.en: Mission: Despacito 2
lines.zh: 任务：Despacito 2

lines.en: scene despacitotwo1
: Ya, ya me está gustando más de lo normal~
lines.zh: Ya, ya me está gustando más de lo normal~

lines.en: : Todos mis sentidos van pidiendo más~
lines.zh: Todos mis sentidos van pidiendo más~

lines.en: : Esto hay que tomarlo sin ningún apuro~
lines.zh: Esto hay que tomarlo sin ningún apuro~

lines.en: : SING IT, AMI!
lines.zh: SING IT, AMI!

lines.en: : Despacito...
lines.zh: Despacito...

lines.en: : Dadadada Despacito...
lines.zh: Dadadada Despacito...

lines.en: : Dadadadadadada Despacito
lines.zh: Dadadadadadada Despacito

lines.en: : Dadadadadada Despacito...
lines.zh: Dadadadadada Despacito...

lines.en: : DES-PA-CITO!
lines.zh: DES-PA-CITO!

lines.en: scene despacitotwo2
: Would you mind explaining to me why we’re in the hallway instead of next to the people I came here with?
lines.zh: : 您能解释一下，为什么我们待在走廊上，而不是和跟我一起来的人坐在一起吗？

lines.en: : You came here with me as well, remember? Ayane dragged both of us along.
lines.zh: : 你也是跟我一起来的，记得吗？Ayane 把咱们俩都拖来了。

lines.en: : I only needed to be dragged after finding out you were coming.
lines.zh: : 我是在得知您也要来之后，才需要被拖着的。

lines.en: : I was a willing participant up until that point.
lines.zh: : 在那之前，我可是自愿参加的。

lines.en: : Would you rather be in there listening to Despacito for the fifth time today?
lines.zh: : 那你宁愿在里面听今天第五遍 Despacito？

lines.en: scene despacitotwo3
: Good point. Please carry on.
lines.zh: : 说得有道理。请继续。

lines.en: School ended a few hours ago and, somehow or another, I wound up coming here with a few of the girls after stopping back at their dorms.
lines.zh: 课几个小时前就结束了，不知怎么的，我陪几个女孩回了一趟宿舍，最后就跟着她们来到这里。

lines.en: I had initially tried tracking down Makoto again, but wasn’t able to find her before she managed to get home.
lines.zh: 一开始我还试着再去找 Makoto，可没等找到，她就先回家了。

lines.en: So, not knowing what else to do about the matter, I seek out an all-knowing creature named Maya Makinami.
lines.zh: 所以，在这件事上我实在不知道还能怎么办，只好去求助一个叫做 Maya Makinami 的全知生物。

lines.en: She’ll probably have some idea of what’s going on with our faithful class representative.
lines.zh: 她大概会知道我们那位尽职的班长到底怎么了。

lines.en: : I was wondering if you’ve noticed anything different about Makoto lately.
lines.zh: : 我想问问你，最近有没有觉得 Makoto 有什么不对劲。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo2
: You mean how she looks dead inside?
lines.zh: : 您是说她看起来已经心如死灰了？

lines.en: : Yeah, that.
lines.zh: : 对，就是那个。

lines.en: : Yes. It would be impossible {i}not{/i} to notice.
lines.zh: : 有。想{i}不注意{/i}到都难。

lines.en: : What did you do to her?
lines.zh: : 您对她做了什么？

lines.en: : I can’t absolve you of your sins, but it will at least help me prepare in the event of you attempting to do the same thing to me.
lines.zh: : 我没法赦免您的罪，但至少能让我提前做好准备，万一您想对我做同样的事。

lines.en: : I didn’t do anything...
lines.zh: : 我什么都没做……

lines.en: : She just randomly became all dark and gloomy after the two of us went up to the roof a while ago.
lines.zh: : 就在前阵子我们俩上天台之后，她突然就变得阴暗消沉了。

lines.en: : The roof as in...the roof of the[school]?
lines.zh: : 天台是指……[school]的天台？

lines.en: : That’s probably the only roof I’ve been on in years, so yeah.
lines.zh: : 那大概是我这几年唯一上过的天台，所以，对。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo4
: What were you two doing up there? That place is off limits.
lines.zh: : 你俩在上面干什么？那个地方是禁止入内的。

lines.en: : That’s never stopped you.
lines.zh: : 这可从来没拦住过你。

lines.en: : I’m only there once every few months. It’s not like I spend my nights off hanging out up there.
lines.zh: : 我几个月才去一次。我又不是一有空就跑上去待着。

lines.en: : Really? Because I wouldn’t put that past you.
lines.zh: : 是吗？毕竟这种事我可一点都不觉得你干不出来。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo5
: Whatever. Why does this involve me?
lines.zh: : 随便吧。这事跟我有什么关系？

lines.en: : I barely ever talk to Makoto. I have no idea what’s going on with her.
lines.zh: : 我几乎没跟 Makoto 说过话。我完全不知道她怎么了。

lines.en: : She’s probably just upset that the guy she likes is a creep.
lines.zh: : 她大概只是因为喜欢的男人是个变态而难过。

lines.en: : So there’s nothing...weird about the rooftop that would cause her to like...short-circuit or something?
lines.zh: : 所以天台没有什么……奇怪的地方，会让她……短路之类的？

lines.en: scene despacitotwo6
: Short circuit?...
: Do you think we’re all robots now? Is that your new theory?
lines.zh: : 您现在觉得我们都是机器人了？这就是您的新理论？

lines.en: : I’m assuming that answer means it’s just a normal rooftop after all?
lines.zh: : 我猜这个回答的意思是，那终究只是个普通的天台？

lines.en: scene despacitotwo7
: Of course it’s just a normal rooftop.
lines.zh: : 那当然只是个普通的天台。

lines.en: : The only thing special about it is that it’s the highest point of the city. Other than that it’s just a roof.
lines.zh: : 它唯一特别的地方，就是它是这座城市的最高点。除此之外，它就只是个天台。

lines.en: : Then why do you always go there to do the reset thing? I thought it had some sort of powers or something.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么总是去那里做重置那套？我还以为它有什么特殊力量之类的。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo8
: Oh, I don’t really know. I just kind of went there the first time the world ended because strange things tend to happen on rooftops in a lot of the manga and games I read.
lines.zh: : 哦，其实我也不知道。世界第一次终结的时候，我就是随便去了那里，因为我读的很多漫画和游戏里，奇怪的事总喜欢发生在天台上。

lines.en: : I’ve just kept going back ever since.
lines.zh: : 从那以后我就一直回去。

lines.en: : I guess you could say it’s become a bit of a tradition.
lines.zh: : 大概可以说，这已经成了一种传统。

lines.en: : I forgot you were even into that kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 我都忘了你还喜欢这些东西。

lines.en: : Yes. Surprise. I have interests.
lines.zh: : 是啊。意外吧。我也有爱好。

lines.en: : My life does not revolve around sweeping a shrine and waiting for you to ask me the right questions.
lines.zh: : 我的人生可不是只围着扫神社、等您问出正确的问题打转。

lines.en: : To be fair, though, the rooftop {i}is{/i} technically the only place I’ve ever watched the world change. So maybe there’s something to it after all?
lines.zh: : 不过说句公道话，严格来说天台{i}是{/i}我唯一目睹过世界改变的地方。所以也许它确实有点名堂？

lines.en: : I really expected you to have a little more information than just that.
lines.zh: : 我还真指望你能知道得比这多一点。

lines.en: : I’m sorry to have let you down.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉让您失望了。

lines.en: : You don’t look very sorry.
lines.zh: : 你看上去一点也不抱歉。

lines.en: : I’m not. I was lying.
lines.zh: : 我确实不抱歉。我刚才在撒谎。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo9
: The thing with Makoto is kind of strange, though.
lines.zh: : 不过 Makoto 这件事确实有点奇怪。

lines.en: : If she started acting that way after coming down from the rooftop and what you’re saying about not assaulting her is true, maybe she...saw something?
lines.zh: : 如果她是从天台下来之后才变成那样的，而您说您没有对她动手也是真的，那她也许是……看见了什么？

lines.en: scene despacitotwo10
: Did she say anything you found odd?
lines.zh: : 她有没有说过什么让您觉得奇怪的话？

lines.en: : Anything I found odd?
lines.zh: : 让我觉得奇怪的话？

lines.en: Hmm...
Pretty much everything she said yesterday struck me as odd.
lines.zh: 昨天她说的几乎每一句话，我都觉得奇怪。

lines.en: The girl near the lockers was barely even Makoto at all.
lines.zh: 储物柜旁的那个女孩，几乎根本就不是 Makoto。

lines.en: There was no hope left in her eyes.
lines.zh: 她眼里已经没有一丝希望。

lines.en: All I saw was an unending emptiness that not even the glare of the fluorescent hallway lights could brighten up.
lines.zh: 我看到的只有无尽的空洞，就连走廊荧光灯刺眼的光芒也无法照亮它。

lines.en: : She did start talking about how everything is pointless and how god isn’t real at some point.
lines.zh: : 她确实有那么一阵开始说，一切都没有意义，还有神并不存在。

lines.en: : And then what?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : And then I...
lines.zh: : 然后我……

lines.en: : Well?
lines.zh: : 说啊？

lines.en: : And then I kind of instinctively pinned her against the locker and asked her to come up to the roof with me.
lines.zh: : 然后我有点本能地把她按在储物柜上，要她跟我上天台。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo11
: Are you sure {i}you're{/i} not the one who needs help?
lines.zh: : 您确定需要帮助的人不是{i}您自己{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Because it sounds to me like she was just depressed and you tried to take advantage of that to bring her somewhere private.
lines.zh: : 因为听您这么说，我觉得她只是抑郁了，而您想趁机把她带到没人的地方去。

lines.en: : Yeah, that part doesn’t sound good thinking back on it.
lines.zh: : 是啊，现在回想起来，那一段确实不怎么好听。

lines.en: : But I swear, something is going on with her.
lines.zh: : 但我发誓，她确实是出事了。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo12
: Well, on the bright side, it’s possible that she’ll go back to normal very soon.
lines.zh: : 好吧，往好处想，她也许很快就会恢复正常。

lines.en: : With the world ending again in the next few days or weeks, she might just be the normal Makoto again once we usher in Winter.
lines.zh: : 世界再过几天或几周就要再次终结，等我们迎来冬天的时候，她说不定又变回那个正常的 Makoto 了。

lines.en: : But I guess we won’t really know until that happens.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，在那之前我们是不会知道的。

lines.en: : Has anyone ever changed that drastically before?
lines.zh: : 以前有人发生过这么剧烈的变化吗？

lines.en: scene despacitotwo13
: Yuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuup.
: That’s directed at me, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那是冲我来的，对吧？

lines.en: : Was it my eyebrows or my eyes that gave you that idea?
lines.zh: : 是我的眉毛，还是我的眼睛让您这么想的？

lines.en: : Or perhaps the elongated “yup?”
lines.zh: : 还是那个拖长的「有」？

lines.en: : A mixture of all three. Was I really that bad?
lines.zh: : 三个都有。我真有那么糟吗？

lines.en: : Don’t even get me started.
lines.zh: : 说起来就没完了。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo14
: But yes. Changes like that are possible. Though they seem to be very rare for anyone but you.
lines.zh: : 不过，是的。那样的变化是可能的。只是对您以外的人来说，似乎非常罕见。

lines.en: : You’re an entirely different case. You change personalities faster than a girl getting off of a long-term relationship changes her hairstyle.
lines.zh: : 您是完全不同的个案。您换人格的速度，比一个刚结束长期恋情的女生换发型还快。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you even made it this far as {i}you{/i}, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我很惊讶您居然能以{i}「您自己」{/i}的状态活到现在。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how much trouble you’ve caused me in the past?
lines.zh: : 您知道自己过去给我添了多少麻烦吗？

lines.en: : I feel like I’m being scolded right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得自己正在挨骂。

lines.en: I can hear Maya take a deep breath as she desperately prevents herself from carrying on her impromptu lecture any further.
lines.zh: 我听见 Maya 深吸一口气，拼命阻止自己把这场即兴说教继续下去。

lines.en: : I’m going back inside now.
lines.zh: : 我要回里面去了。

lines.en: : Ayane will probably take a break after one or two more Despacitos and then we can order food and I will finally feel whole again.
lines.zh: : Ayane 大概再唱一两首 Despacito 就会休息，然后我们就能点吃的了，我也终于能重新做个完整的人。

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll follow you in.
lines.zh: : 好。我跟你进去。

lines.en: : Please do not.
lines.zh: : 请您别跟来。

lines.en: scene black
Maya walks into the karaoke booth and, lo and behold, Ayane is singing the same song as always.
lines.zh: Maya 走进卡拉 OK 包厢，果不其然，Ayane 又在唱那首万年不变的歌。

lines.en: Ami reluctantly sings along, albeit with significantly worse Spanish, and I question why these girls continue to bring Ayane here if all they ever get out of it is misery.
lines.zh: Ami 不太情愿地跟着唱，西班牙语还要烂得多，我不禁想问，既然每次来都只换来折磨，这些女孩为什么还要一直把 Ayane 带来。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo15
: Why are you sitting right next to me?
lines.zh: : 您为什么坐在我旁边？

lines.en: : There’s plenty of seating in this room and literally anywhere else would be better than where you chose.
lines.zh: : 这屋里座位多的是，您随便坐哪儿都比您选的这个位置好。

lines.en: : But I wasn’t done talking to you yet.
lines.zh: : 可我还没跟你谈完呢。

lines.en: : But {i}I{/i} was done talking to {i}you{/i}. I really don’t know anything else about Makoto or the rooftop so just wait it out and see what happens.
lines.zh: : 可{i}我{/i}已经跟{i}您{/i}谈完了。关于 Makoto 和天台，我真的什么都不知道了，所以您就等着看会发生什么吧。

lines.en: : Do you have enough self-control to do that? Or are you going to explode?
lines.zh: : 您有足够的自制力做到这点吗？还是说您要爆炸了？

lines.en: : If you’re going to explode, please go back out into the hallway. Ayane’s voice is loud enough. Any more noise will make my ears bleed.
lines.zh: : 如果您要爆炸，请回走廊上去。Ayane 的声音已经够大了。再多一点噪音，我的耳朵都要流血了。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo16
: Hi~
: What are you two doing?
lines.zh: : 你俩在干什么？

lines.en: : You were out in the hallway for a really long time.
lines.zh: : 你们在走廊上待了好久。

lines.en: : If I didn’t know any better, I’d think Maya was trying to steal you from me.
lines.zh: : 要不是我了解情况，我还以为 Maya 想把您从我身边抢走呢。

lines.en: : Please get your [uncle] out of my sight. He’s roughly three miles too close right now.
lines.zh: : 请把您的[uncle]从我眼前弄走。他现在大概还近了三英里。

lines.en: : Okay now that’s just excessive.
lines.zh: : 好了，这话说得也太夸张了。

lines.en: : Heheh~ This is exactly why I wasn’t worried about you two being alone.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 这正是我不担心你俩独处的原因。

lines.en: : Did I hear Makoto’s name come up, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，我好像听到 Makoto 的名字了？

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Still trying to figure out what’s going on with her.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。还在想办法搞清楚她怎么了。

lines.en: : No luck yesterday then?
lines.zh: : 那昨天没什么收获？

lines.en: : None at all.
lines.zh: : 一点都没有。

lines.en: : Oh well. I guess all there is to do is just let her be swallowed by her infinite sadness and get on with our lives.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我看也只能任她被无尽的悲伤吞没，我们继续过自己的日子了。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo17
: And speaking of getting on with our lives...
lines.zh: : 说到继续过日子……

lines.en: : ...What?
: Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么看着我？

lines.en: : Because we’re going shopping for winter clothes together soon.
lines.zh: : 因为我们很快就要一起去买冬装了。

lines.en: : ...Okay, but why does that call for angry eyebrows and a maniacal grin?
lines.zh: : ……好吧，可这有什么需要竖起眉毛、露出疯狂笑容的？

lines.en: scene despacitotwo18
: I don’t know. I just felt like making that face. Like I was forcing you to come even though I know you like trying on new clothes.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我就是想做那个表情。就像我在逼你去一样，尽管我知道你喜欢试新衣服。

lines.en: : You do?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢？

lines.en: scene despacitotwo19
: Yes. Surprise. I have interests.
lines.zh: : 是啊。意外吧。我也有爱好。

lines.en: : You should come too, Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei 您也来吧！

lines.en: : I still haven’t started at the maid cafe yet, so I don’t have any money and I need you to buy me warm stuff or I will freeze to death and you’ll have to pay even more for a funeral.
lines.zh: : 我还没开始去女仆咖啡店上班，所以身上一分钱都没有，我得让您给我买保暖的衣服，不然我会冻死，到时候您还得花更多钱办葬礼。

lines.en: : I can just bury you in the backyard, it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 我把你埋在后院就行了，没问题的。

lines.en: : That works. At least my ghost wouldn’t have to walk very far to find you.
lines.zh: : 那也行。至少我的鬼魂不用走太远就能找到您。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo20
: Unfortunately, Sensei has plans that day and can not accompany us. What a shame.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，Sensei 那天有事，不能陪我们去了。真是可惜。

lines.en: : Don’t just decide I have plans, Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya，别擅自替我决定我有事。

lines.en: : It was worth a shot.
lines.zh: : 不试白不试。

lines.en: : So you’ll come then?
lines.zh: : 那您会来咯？

lines.en: : Sure. Not like I have anything else I need to do.
lines.zh: : 好啊。反正我也没什么别的事。

lines.en: : Tomorrow night is fine, right? Does that work for everyone?
lines.zh: : 明天晚上可以吧？大家时间都合适吗？

lines.en: : DEESSS-PAAAFFFFFTTTT- TOMORROW?!
lines.zh: : DEESSS-PAAAFFFFFTTTT——明天？！

lines.en: scene despacitotwo21
: But I have stuff to do tomorrow and I wanna come!
lines.zh: : 可我明天有事啊，我也想去！

lines.en: : You and I can go together a different day, Ayane.
lines.zh: : Ayane，那我们改天再去。

lines.en: : Yeah! But I’m going to come to that too so I can make sure Ayane keeps her hands off of you.
lines.zh: : 好耶！不过那次我也要去，这样我才能保证 Ayane 不乱碰您。

lines.en: scene despacitotwo22
: It’s fine. You’ll still be able to help me out in the fitting room, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 没关系。Sensei 您还是可以在试衣间里帮我的忙呀。

lines.en: : No you will not. That’s not even legal.
lines.zh: : 不行，你不能。那甚至根本不合法。

lines.en: : Hah...
: This really never stops being troublesome...
lines.zh: : 这件事真是永远都这么麻烦……

lines.en: scene black
And so we proceed to finalize our plans for winter shopping tomorrow night.
lines.zh: 于是我们敲定了明天晚上去买冬装的计划。

lines.en: Apparently, the mall normally gets busy this time of year with people shopping for their significant others and whatnot.
lines.zh: 据说这个时节商场通常会很挤，大家都要给自己的另一半买东西什么的。

lines.en: Just, with so many significant others being {b}in fucking space{/b}, I can’t imagine the mall will be nearly as busy as Ami expects it to be.
lines.zh: 只不过，那么多另一半{b}都他妈的在太空里{/b}，我实在想象不出商场会有 Ami 预期的那么挤。

lines.en: Either way, it looks like tomorrow might wind up being a bit more eventful than an average Friday, so I’ll need to brace my wallet and prepare for whatever is to come.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，看来明天会比平常的周五热闹一点，所以我得捂紧钱包，为即将到来的一切做好准备。

lines.en: I’m sure it will all be worth it in the end, though.
lines.zh: 不过我敢说，到最后一切都是值得的。

lines.en: Winter clothes are a special type of attractive.
lines.zh: 冬装有一种特别的吸引力。

lines.en: I’m all about seeing cute girls naked, but something about layers upon layers upon layers makes me feel a little different than any other type of outfit possibly can.
lines.zh: 我是很喜欢看可爱女生裸着的样子，但一层又一层、又一层叠着的衣服，给我的感觉是其他任何装扮都不可能带来的。

lines.en: Some people may tell you that the reason for this is because it adds to the mystery of {i}what could be underneath the clothes{/i}-
lines.zh: 有人也许会告诉你，这是因为它能增加{i}「衣服下面会是什么」{/i}的神秘感——

lines.en: But, as someone who has seen a sizable portion of these girls nude already, I can guarantee it’s much more than that.
lines.zh: 但作为一个已经看过这些女生中相当一部分裸体的人，我可以保证，远不止如此。

lines.en: And suddenly, tomorrow can’t come soon enough...
lines.zh: 突然之间，明天来得再快都不够……
